items.headline: Bill Connelly's Week 2 preview: Big Ten-SEC challenge, early conference tests
items.description: Bluebloods have a chance at the early-season's biggest win. Big 12 and SEC have early conference challenges, and the G6 has an elimination weekend.

items.headline: Week 2 GameDay Kickoff: QB issues for Michigan, Buckeyes-Horns and more
items.description: The problems at QB run deep for Michigan, plus what to expect in Texas-Ohio State and other Week 2 games.

items.headline: Kamario Taylor on how MS State's unified offense can be a threat soon
items.description: Taylor recaps the Bulldogs' performance vs. UL Monroe as he discusses the potential their offense has of being a threat this season and plays he prefers to use most as a QB.

items.headline: Mississippi State squares off against Minnesota in Week 2
items.description: Mississippi State (1-0) at Minnesota (1-0), Sept. 12 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: SEC schedules vote about whether to expel LSU, amends lawsuit
items.description: The SEC has filed an amended complaint against LSU regarding its potential plans to add ex-NFL players and scheduled a vote on whether to expel the Tigers.
items.byline: Pete Thamel and Mark Schlabach and Dan Murphy
